leftEvidence.title: God’s work is finished and the seventh day is marked

points.label: Completion
points.left: Creation work is described as finished.
points.right: Hebrews explicitly cites works finished from the foundation of the world.

points.label: Rest
points.left: God rests on the seventh day.
points.right: The argument says a Sabbath rest remains for God’s people.

points.label: Time
points.left: The marked day closes the creation sequence.
points.right: The same text is used in an argument that extends beyond that day.

payload.posture: Read the creation statement first, then observe how Hebrews places it inside a larger argument.

rightEvidence.title: The seventh-day text is cited while another rest remains in view

payload.tension: Genesis locates rest at the completion of creation, while Hebrews still speaks of a rest open to enter.
payload.title: Finished rest / continuing rest
